description.value: Vehicle and passenger ferry operator serving coastal BC. Key routes for cyclists: Horseshoe Bay to Nanaimo (Departure Bay and Duke Point), Tsawwassen to Swartz Bay and Duke Point, and routes to the Sunshine Coast, Gulf Islands, and Vancouver Island. Bikes travel free (you pay only a passenger fare). E-bikes are welcome on all routes; no charging at terminals or on board.

Accommodates bicycles.detail: Bikes travel free (passenger fare only); bike racks on vehicle deck; e-bikes welcome on all routes

E-bikes OK.detail: no charging at terminals or on board
